description: A DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCE, not a target. Python stages through mkstemp and lands 0600 whatever the umask is; rust inherits the umask, which @baud measured at 664 under 0002 and 644 under 0022 — so it is not a constant on their side and cannot be written as one here. PLATFORM: mode is a POSIX property. Windows has no 0600 semantics, so where the bits do not survive a round trip there is NO mode expectation — and the rest of the case (the document written, the view returned) still runs and still counts.
notes: Divergence 6. Convergence is a Patrick ruling parked for morning — this case documents, it does not force.
